mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reviews ( reservation_id, rating, content ) VALUES ( #{reservationId}, #{rating}, #{content} )
mapper.select: SELECT r.id AS id, r.reservation_id AS reservationId, res.guest_user_id AS memberId, res.place_id AS placeId, DATE(res.check_in_at) AS checkInAt, p.name AS placeName, r.content AS content, r.rating AS rating FROM reviews r JOIN reservations res ON r.reservation_id = res.id JOIN places p ON res.place_id = p.id WHERE res.guest_user_id = #{memberId} AND r.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY r.created_at DESC

SELECT r.id AS id, r.reservation_id AS reservationId, res.guest_user_id AS memberId, res.place_id AS placeId, DATE(res.check_in_at) AS checkInAt, p.name AS placeName, r.content AS content, r.rating AS rating FROM reviews r JOIN reservations res ON r.reservation_id = res.id JOIN places p ON res.place_id = p.id WHERE res.place_id = #{placeId} AND r.deleted_at IS NULL
ORDER BY r.rating DESC, r.created_at DESC
ORDER BY r.rating ASC, r.created_at DESC
ORDER BY r.created_at DESC

SELECT r.id, r.reservation_id AS reservationId, res.guest_user_id AS memberId, res.place_id AS placeId, p.name AS placeName, res.check_in_at AS checkInAt, r.content, r.rating FROM reviews r JOIN reservations res ON r.reservation_id = res.id JOIN places p ON res.place_id = p.id WHERE r.id = #{id}
